shortDescription: Sui said on X that tokenized real-world assets issued by Bitwise can be used as collateral for Bluefin Lend on the Sui blockchain. According to Odaily, the announcement said the assets are available for use on the network as collateral.

title: Sui Says Bitwise Tokenized Real-World Assets Can Be Used as Bluefin Lend Collateral
